steps.en: The days before the due date can be set through a parameter
steps.id: Jumlah hari sebelum jatuh tempo bisa diatur lewat parameter
steps.why_en: The parameter exists but is keyed to parking reminder stages, not court.
steps.why_id: Parameter ada tapi untuk stage reminder parking, bukan court.

steps.en: OCMS selects court summonses that fall due within X days
steps.id: OCMS memilih batch court summons yang jatuh tempo dalam X hari
steps.why_en: Only parking reminder stages are selected; court due dates are not used.
steps.why_id: Hanya stage reminder parking yang dipilih; due date court tidak dipakai.

steps.en: OCMS checks whether payment has been made
steps.id: OCMS memeriksa apakah pembayaran sudah dilakukan
steps.why_en: No direct payment check; only an indirect filter, and only for parking reminders.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada cek bayar langsung; hanya filter tidak langsung, dan hanya untuk reminder parking.

steps.en: The check result decides whether SMS/email is sent
steps.id: Hasil cek menentukan apakah SMS/email dikirim
steps.why_en: Check-then-send exists only for parking reminders, and the job is switched off in the repo config.
steps.why_id: Cek lalu kirim hanya ada untuk reminder parking, dan job-nya mati di konfigurasi repo.
